senses.gloss:
भेक m. (-कः)
 1. A frog.
 2. A cloud.
 3. A timid man.
 f. (-की)
 1. The
female of the frog, or a small frog.
 2. A kind of creeper, (Hydro-
cotyle Asiatica.)
 E. भी to fear, Unādi aff. कन्.

भेकपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A creeper, (Hydrocetyle Asiatica.)
 E. भेक frog, and
पर्ण a leaf; resembling the animal.

भेकभुज् m. (-भुक्) A serpent, a snake.
 E. भेक, and भुज् who eats.
भेकरव m. (-वः) The croaking of frogs.
